name: Reinald Jaeger
original_name: ライナルト・イェーガー
source: Although he is Irma's older brother, Rainart attacks [url=/c96494]Jean DuPont[/url] as a soldier of the Erectus army, aiming for the holy sword. In addition to Rainart's own abilities, his physical prowess is further strengthened by the magic sword, making him much stronger than any other soldier in the Erectus army. Due to the influence of his magic sword, his ego is almost nonexistent.
